data.remedy: The homeserver no longer knows the device Twalk acts through: the owner revoked it, or an admin did. Until another is held, every approved reply to a bridged conversation is refused rather than posted to nobody. The owner can hand over a new device by onboarding again in the Companion, with nothing to restart; an operator can replace SENSOR_OWNER_DEVICE_ACCESS_TOKEN by running docker-compose/provision-owner-device.sh and restarting the Sensor. This is not a homeserver that is unreachable — that answers differently and is retried.
